project: Mario Sports Mix native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Reaches the Basketball menus. Known problem: starting a match stops the game (its code modules are compressed on the disc and aren't translated yet). Tested on Windows 11 by playing into the first real scene; on the Linux mini PC through the menus. Nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
